lines.zh: 我在水里滑行，像条长蛇
lines.en: I glide through the water like a long snake.

lines.zh: 我的身体一节一节地摆过去
lines.en: My body ripples forward, segment by segment.
One beat of my tail carries me far.
I skim along the riverbed.
I swim faster than any boat.

lines.zh: 我绕开水草，直直冲过去
lines.en: I avoid the weeds and drive straight on.
My scales carry a wet sheen.

lines.zh: 我从深水一路游到浅处
lines.en: I come from deep water into the shallows.
I hug the bank's stone wall.
My shadow sweeps the bottom.
I edge closer to the bank.

lines.zh: 我转了个弯，水道都动了
lines.en: I turn, and the water channel shifts.
I lie low, only my back showing.

lines.zh: 我盘在河底，等云压下来
lines.en: I coil on the riverbed and wait for the clouds to sink.
Water flows over me.
I hold still like sunken timber.
My gills keep working.
I listen for footsteps on the bank.

lines.zh: 这片水域没什么能威胁我
lines.en: Nothing in these waters threatens me.
My head rests below the surface.
I am thinking about things on land.
I coil up slowly.
There is rain in the air.
I am waiting for full dark.
My tail tip taps the water.
The water here is deep enough.
You stand on the bank, close to the water.
I rise, and the surface drops.

lines.zh: 我这条比你整条船都长
lines.en: I am longer than your whole boat.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西是干海带吗
lines.en: Is that dried kelp in your hand?
I swim far faster than you.
I am waiting for you to step in.

lines.zh: 你的衣服上有云的气味
lines.en: Your clothes carry the smell of clouds.

lines.zh: 我抬头，水从我的角上流下
lines.en: I lift my head and water runs off my horns.
You do not dare enter the water.
My jaws have opened underwater.
You cannot see how long I am.
Move back, I am coming ashore.

lines.zh: 我浮起来，水漫到你的靴口
lines.en: I rise until the water laps your boot tops.
I know this river's depth.
Do not put your hand in.
I turn my head toward you.
The scales on me are peeled back.
I press my body down into the river mud.
That bite hurt.
I turn over in the water.
My gills clamp shut.
I press my head lower.
The water took part of it.

lines.zh: 鳞缝里渗出的血染了水
lines.en: Blood seeps from between my scales into the water.
One beat of my tail still swims.
I am slowly recovering.
That smells like dragon meat.
I smell dried kelp.

lines.zh: 把肉扔在水里，我自会去捡
lines.en: Toss the meat in the water and I'll fetch it.
I have to come ashore first.
That much meat barely wets my teeth.
I swim a little toward the bank.

lines.zh: 我不吃活的东西以外的
lines.en: I only eat things that were alive.
Step back three paces first.
In the water, I am not picky.
I open my jaws a little.
You hit my flank.
I am far taller than you.
The water shoves you back.
I slide past you.

lines.zh: 我侧身时鳞片蹭过你的膝
lines.en: My scales brush your knee as I turn.
You stepped on my scales.
We throw the water up high.
The water cools as we pass.
I turn my body aside.
Do not come along the waterline.
I must be struck by lightning first.
That has to wait for a rainy day.
You cannot help with this.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣得先把我引上岸
lines.en: A mate must first draw me ashore.
These things cannot be said in water.
I sink down to the bottom.
All I lack is a lightning bolt.

lines.zh: 等雷雨落到这条河上再说
lines.en: Not until a thunderstorm falls on this river.
I twist my head the other way.
We will speak when you are gone.
What sinks is mine.
I swallow it in one go.
It is light in the water.
I push it to the bank.
I sniff; it is not fresh.
It is stuck between my teeth.

lines.zh: 我叼着这东西沉回深处
lines.en: I carry it down into the deep.
Whoever dropped it, it is mine.
This is not nearly enough.
I press it to the bottom.
You stepped into my river.
You are marked as mine.
My jaws are open.
There is no place for you in this water.
I am faster than you.

lines.zh: 你身上有雨的味道，很好
lines.en: You smell of rain, good.
I will wait until you are ashore.
These waters are mine.
I have cut your retreat first.
Do not run for the deep water.
I coil my body slowly.

lines.zh: 我在水里，你跑不出这条河
lines.en: I'm in the water; you can't outrun this river.

lines.zh: 我把长脖子探出了水面
lines.en: I lift my long neck out of the water.
You cannot dodge this.
I swim beneath you.

lines.zh: 我用尾巴在你腰后画了个圈
lines.en: My tail draws a circle behind your waist.
Back toward the bank, and I follow.
I wait for the water to shallow.

lines.zh: 你数的每一步我都记着
lines.en: I mark every step you take.
My body stretches far underwater.
I hug the bed without a sound.
You can hear the water change.
I draw a little nearer.
You should not turn your back.
The tips of my teeth break the surface.
You are forced against the rocks.
I know every inch of this stretch.
I wait for you to step in.
My tail is set.
I close my jaws and bite.

lines.zh: 我的牙咬穿了你的护腿
lines.en: My teeth pierce your leggings.
You are dragged into the water.
The splash covers your shout.
I shake my head and throw you.
That bite was heavy.
My teeth come in rows.
You tore free of my jaws.
I will try once more.
The water is where I rule.
My tail tip cracks across your back.

lines.zh: 你退到岸上，我停在水里
lines.en: You reach the bank; I stop at the water.
Blood thins out in the water.
I used half my strength.
I come up from deep water.
The surface bulges.
This river is deep enough at last.
I have swum up from downstream.

lines.zh: 我的头露出水面，河都静了
lines.en: My head breaks the surface and the river quiets.

lines.zh: 我盘起来，占了大半条水道
lines.en: I coil and take most of the channel.
I churn the silt up.
There is rain in this water.
First I tested the depth.
Everything on the bank is backing away.
My scales gleam underwater.
I unfold my body slowly.

lines.zh: 我选了一段安静的河湾
lines.en: I picked a quiet bend.

lines.zh: 我的影子盖住了整段河底
lines.en: My shadow covers the whole bed.
I arrive quietly.
There are fish enough here for a long while.
The water heats and my scales burn.
I fall off the bank back into the water.

lines.zh: 水太多也会压得我喘不上气
lines.en: Even I can be smothered by too much water.

lines.zh: 爆炸把水掀开，我翻了个身
lines.en: The blast lifts the water and rolls me over.
An arrow bites my flank.

lines.zh: 魔法穿进水里，烧着我的鳃
lines.en: Magic pierces the water and burns my gills.
There are no fish left in this river.

lines.zh: 雷打在水面上，我的身体一抽
lines.en: Lightning strikes the water and my body jerks.
The water is gone all at once.
